zechariah.13.p1.b1.text: On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

zechariah.13.p1.b2.text: And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land … And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.

zechariah.13.p1.b3.text: I am not a prophet; I work the land …

zechariah.13.p1.b4.text: Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.

zechariah.13.p1.b5.text: This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver … I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’
